Senses.Explanation: Burning a Buddha image names the Danxia case and its later reuse as a test or verdict. Verses pair the burning with the monastery rector’s fallen eyebrows; another address contrasts an evil person burning an image with praise for hearing scripture. The witnesses do not license general iconoclasm.
